title: F1 proponent: EAST/NORTHEAST/EASTNORTHEAST as substitution + columnar keys
hypothesis_summary: The first disclosed K4 crib EASTNORTHEAST occupies positions 21-33. It splits naturally into EAST and NORTHEAST. The proponent reading mirrors F1-11: these crib words ALSO function as cipher keywords under a Vig/Beau substitution + keyed columnar composition. This pack is the EAST/NORTHEAST counterpart to the BERLIN/CLOCK proponent pack and exists explicitly so the two halves of the disclosed-crib evidence are tested as independent rival keyword-source claims rather than merged into one over-claiming pack.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Disclosed compound plaintext EASTNORTHEAST at indices 21-33.

composition_templates.rationale: Two/three-keyword sub + keyed columnar across the EAST family.

constraints: Allowed keyword pool restricted to EAST family only.
caveats: Same caveat as F1-11: crib spans need not be keys.
PROPONENT framing — included for symmetric coverage of the disclosed-crib evidence.
